### Install this beta

**macOS / Linux**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aksisonline/gitswitch/main/.github/install.sh | bash -s -- __TAG__
```

**Windows — PowerShell**
```powershell
$env:GS_VERSION="__TAG__"; irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aksisonline/gitswitch/main/.github/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Windows — Command Prompt**
```cmd
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aksisonline/gitswitch/main/.github/install.cmd -o install.cmd && install.cmd __TAG__
```
